content.description: Sky is the upgraded decentralized finance protocol from MakerDAO, introducing new stablecoins and governance tokens. As a prominent player in the DeFi Dapps space, MakerDAO (Sky) specializes in delivering high-quality decentralized cdps infrastructure. It natively supports interactions on Ethereum, utilizing modern smart contract standards to ensure capital efficiency and robust security. The platform is dedicated to lowering the barrier to entry for both developers and retail participants. Moving forward, MakerDAO (Sky) focuses on expanding its decentralized capabilities to offer unparalleled utility in the ever-growing blockchain industry.
